title: PlanLabel index 0.1
description: Document-level index of the labelled pages in one PDF. Embedded once per document as planlabel-index.json so that a reader can see what is labelled, and at which conformance level, without opening every page attachment. This schema is deliberately self-contained: a third-party reader must be able to validate an index without also fetching the page-label schema.

provenance.description: aggregate over every page in the document

model.description: the source model the labels were written from, if there was one

pages.description: one entry per labelled page; unlabelled pages are simply absent

sheetId.description: sheet number as printed, e.g. TWP-101

level.description: conformance level this page's label reaches

file.description: name of the embedded label file, e.g. planlabel-p0000.json

extensions.description: namespaced extras; never required by readers
